title: The New Paper Route
story: On his first morning delivering the Gazette, Teddy Sousa pedaled down Main Street with his camera bouncing on his back, and three customers each asked for a little extra with tomorrow's paper. He was sure he would remember, so he wrote nothing down. He did not remember. Can you help him get the right extra to the right porch?
